newsitem.title: USA: Distillates lead US spot prod gains in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Distillates lead US spot prod gains in light trade.

text.p: Distillates led gains in U.S. spot oil products trade Friday with the NYMEX futures market setting the pace and spot activity subdued, traders said.

New York Harbor and U.S. Gulf heating oil, low sulphur diesel and jet fuel prices were up by anywhere from 1.75 to just over 2.25 cents a gallon in the case of NYH jet fuel, while gasoline prices were about 1.50 cents higher.

Players cited little dynamism in the market other than a firming in jet fuel differentials amid buying in NYH. NYH aviation-grade 54-grade jet fuel saw diffs firm 0.65 cent with offers at 1.25 cents over the screen.
"A couple of majors were out buying some good sized parcels," one East Coast trader said.
Gulf Coast 54-grade and low-sulfur 55-grade jet firmed about 0.25 cent, although buyers and sellers were said to be about a half cent apart in the thinly traded low-sulfur market.

New York Harbor gasoline grades had mixed fortunes, with prompt NYH reformulated A4 grade steady with Thursday diffs amid offers of a half cent over the print and winter grade A-8 oxygenated reformulated 0.20-cent firmer at 2.00 cents over.
